title: Borel measurability of the ball and cone mass functions x ↦ μ(B̄_q(x)) and x ↦ μ(X_α(ν(x), x) ∩ B̄_q(x))
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, E := ℝ^{m+1}, μ an s-finite Borel measure on E, ν : E → E a Borel map and α, q ∈ ℝ. Then the functions x ↦ μ(B̄_q(x)) and x ↦ μ({z ∈ E : α|z − x| ≤ |⟨z − x, ν(x)⟩|} ∩ B̄_q(x)) from E to [0, ∞] are Borel measurable.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid (m + 1))) (ν : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)) (α q : ℝ), SFinite μ → Measurable ν → Measurable (fun x : Euclid (m + 1) => μ (closedBall x q)) ∧ Measurable (fun x : Euclid (m + 1) => μ ({z | α * ‖z - x‖ ≤ |inner ℝ (z - x) (ν x)|} ∩ closedBall x q))
